effect_description_eng:
While you have an [TS] trait Digimon or Tamer on the field, you can ignore this card's color requirements.
[Security] Activate this card's [Main] effects.
[Main] Delete 1 of your opponent's level 6 or higher Digimon. Then, you may link this card to 1 of your Digimon on the field without paying the cost.
link_effect_description_eng: [When Attacking] [Once Per Turn] Delete 1 of your opponent's level 5 or lower Digimon.
